content: Chatwoot webhooks: HMAC-SHA256 signature format sha256=HMAC(secret, timestamp.raw_body), delivered via X-Chatwoot-Signature + X-Chatwoot-Timestamp headers, verify against raw body with constant-time compare, dedupe by delivery UUID. Known bug (chatwoot/chatwoot#13809): API-exposed 'secret' field can mismatch the internal hmac_token actually used to sign — check installed version. EspoCRM webhooks sign via Signature header (renamed from X-Signature around v9.0) as webhookId:base64(HMAC-SHA256(payload)).
